# QS-PROC-09 Shot peening coverage (P2)

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-HT02

Scope
This quality specification defines acceptance criteria and verification procedures for shot peening applied to components processed in Plant P2, line P2-L3 using equipment EQ-P2-L3-HT02. This document applies to operations performed under the referenced maintenance and operational procedures.

Requirements table

| Parameter | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Shot peening coverage | Conform to process instructions in SOP-P2-L3-03 and meet final appearance and functional criteria for intended part family |
| Media condition | Use media and handling per MM-P2-L3-HT02 and MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3; media must be inspected before use |
| Heat treat compatibility | Ensure pre- and post-peen thermal processing aligns with furnace setpoints; The austenitizing setpoint for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) is 845 °C. |
| Documentation | Record peen parameters, operator, and inspection results in the production log referenced by SOP-P2-L3-03 |

Inspection method
Visual inspection for uniformity and absence of visible defects shall be performed per SOP-P2-L3-03. Functional verification shall follow acceptance checks defined in SOP-P2-L3-03 and cross-reference MM-P2-L3-HT02 for any heat-treatment-related verifications. Inspectors shall confirm media traceability to MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3 and document findings in the production record.

Nonconformance handling
Nonconforming parts or process deviations discovered during inspection shall be segregated and documented. Notify Quality and Maintenance per SOP-P2-L3-03. Maintenance interventions must reference MM-P2-L3-HT02 and MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3 before returning equipment to service. Final disposition of affected parts shall be determined by Quality in coordination with Production and Maintenance, with actions recorded in the affected lot file.
